prompt.alinti: You're using Claude's most expensive model for work a cheaper one could do. Claude just dropped mods, and here are three things that fix that. A mod that sends the easy stuff, like quick searches or renaming files, to a cheaper model. The expensive one only handles hard work. A meter that warns you before Claude re-reads your whole session, which burns most of your usage. And a panel that tracks every session you're running with progress and time left. The best part? You don't write a single line of code, you describe the mod and Claude builds it.
